2.text: A rookie adventurer fresh from the countryside. She carries the power of a Fire Spirit, though even she isn't sure why. But she doesn't sweat the small stuff! Armed with the spirit's power and her natural cheer, she's charging down the road to becoming a first-class adventurer.

5.text: Uses the spirit's power to cause a huge explosion, inflicting Fire damage on all foes on the field / Increases the Wind resistance of Fire units and Fire multiballs in your party, and Fire units in other players' parties

7.text: Uses the spirit's power to cause a huge explosion, inflicting Fire damage on all foes on the field / Increases the Wind resistance of Fire units and Fire multiballs in your party, and Fire units in other players' parties

2.text: An honest and polite catfolk girl who tries to act grown-up despite her young age. Behind her adorable looks, she is said to hide a tremendous power.

5.text: Surrounds herself with floating rocks, inflicting Fire damage on nearby foes for a period of time / When party leader is Fire, grants Pierce and increases Power Flip damage for the party

7.text: Surrounds herself with floating rocks, inflicting Fire damage on nearby foes for a period of time / When party leader is Fire, grants Pierce and increases Power Flip damage for the party

2.text: The first of the Vesta to become an adventurer in the Palpebran way. With her Spirit Horn, which reads people's emotions, she keeps the harmony with those around her while enjoying her first life outside the Vesta.

5.text: Restores the HP of all units and multiballs in your party, and units in other players' parties (Effect boosted for Water element) / Grants two attack buffs to Water units and Water multiballs

7.text: Restores the HP of all units and multiballs in your party, and units in other players' parties (Effect boosted for Water element) / Grants two attack buffs to Water units and Water multiballs

2.text: The infamous boss of Tsangli, a vast mafia organization that rules the underworld of the Endless Blue. Though little is known of her past, her talent and skill quickly carried her to the top. She is a gangster who is beautiful, terrifying, and at times, kind.

4.note: Four Perils (si zui) are the four villains of Chinese myth, Gonggong among them; shortened.

5.text: Creates a barrier around herself for a period of time, inflicting Water damage, a stackable attack debuff, and a stackable Water resistance debuff on nearby foes

7.text: Creates a barrier around herself for a period of time, inflicting Water damage, a stackable attack debuff, and a stackable Water resistance debuff on nearby foes

2.text: A body designer who creates android bodies. Her designs are strikingly novel and outlandish, favoring forms no ordinary android would have, such as multiple arms and legs. Her clients invariably say, "Before I knew it, my body had been set free."

5.text: Wields multiple arms, inflicting Thunder damage on nearby foes / Increases Power Flip damage for the party / Removes 1 debuff from Thunder units and Thunder multiballs

7.text: Wields multiple arms, inflicting Thunder damage on nearby foes / Increases Power Flip damage for the party / Removes 1 debuff from Thunder units and Thunder multiballs

2.text: Yin and yang, black and white. Chaos is inverted, and the maiden is cloaked in a world of white. In other words, cute white outfits aren't really Denah's thing, but she's adopting one as her new style anyway.

5.text: Strikes a pose to show off her new outfit / Tentacles attack the nearest foe, inflicting Thunder damage and reduced Thunder resistance on hit foes / If activated outside of Fever state, increases Fever Gauge

7.text: Strikes a pose to show off her new outfit / Tentacles attack the nearest foe, inflicting Thunder damage and reduced Thunder resistance on hit foes / If activated outside of Fever state, increases Fever Gauge

2.text: Handsome, wealthy, and well-born. Yet his friends all say the same thing: "He's an adorable coward, that one." So no matter how fine a suit he wears, there's no way Libby could gracefully escort a lady... Wait, Libby?

5.text: Puts on a lavish show across the field, removing 1 buff from all foes / Increases Thunder leader attack / Removes 1 debuff from Thunder units and Thunder multiballs

7.text: Puts on a lavish show across the field, removing 1 buff from all foes / Increases Thunder leader attack / Removes 1 debuff from Thunder units and Thunder multiballs

2.text: Nagiri Amo, a 16-year-old first-year high school student. A sword prodigy named rightful heir to the Amo Style by her grandfather, a Living National Treasure. At a glance she seems a well-bred young lady with the air of a class president, but her blade flashes like lightning to pass judgment.

5.text: Performs an iaido strike in front, inflicting Thunder damage on hit foes / If HP is above 50% when activated, deals additional damage to self

7.text: Performs an iaido strike in front, inflicting Thunder damage on hit foes / If HP is above 50% when activated, deals additional damage to self

2.text: The top gravure-type idol who conquered the BRASS, a proxy war in which twelve mysterious nations stake their prestige. Her immense Cosmic Power and love for idols don't waver one bit, even off duty. Her catchphrase is "Cowdy."

5.text: Shows off an alluring candid shot, increasing Wind leader attack / When party leader is Wind, increases Power Flip damage for the party / Increases combo count

7.text: Shows off an alluring candid shot, increasing Wind leader attack / When party leader is Wind, increases Power Flip damage for the party / Increases combo count

2.text: Yae Asato, a 16-year-old first-year high school student with the power of freedom. In search of something to be passionate about, she drifts along as a carefree adventurer while sightseeing in other worlds. She's sociable, and doesn't really do personal space.

5.text: Rains countless arrows down on the nearest foe, inflicting Wind damage on hit and nearby foes / Increases direct hit damage for Wind units + Removes 1 debuff / Grants Levitate to all units and multiballs in your party

7.text: Rains countless arrows down on the nearest foe, inflicting Wind damage on hit and nearby foes / Increases direct hit damage for Wind units + Removes 1 debuff / Grants Levitate to all units and multiballs in your party

8.note: Pun: yae means eightfold, her given name.

2.text: A knight who has led the Canids to victory in countless battles. Having realized his mistakes, he now seeks a path he can truly believe in.

4.note: German-styled like his earlier skill Mordhau; reading of the katakana uncertain.

5.text: Rushes the nearest foe with slashes and explosions, inflicting Wind damage on hit and nearby foes / When party leader is Wind, increases Power Flip damage for the party

7.text: Rushes the nearest foe with slashes and explosions, inflicting Wind damage on hit and nearby foes / When party leader is Wind, increases Power Flip damage for the party

2.text: Taichi Yuhino, 41. A man who chased an illusion into the vast void that took his friends and family, and never found his way back. He has wandered and wandered, turning away from his hopes and wishes. But now, before his eyes, "everything" is beginning to reveal itself.

5.text: Slashes forward, inflicting Wind damage on hit foes / Increases attack and skill damage for self

7.text: Slashes forward, inflicting Wind damage on hit foes / Increases attack and skill damage for self

2.text: The great Holy Dragon, who has lived through the most ages of all six Ancient Dragons. Wishing for a little princess's future, he left his power to her out of love and was reborn... as the cockiest little thing you ever did see.

5.text: Displays the majesty of an Ancient Dragon, inflicting a stackable Light resistance debuff on all foes on the field + Removes 1 buff / Emits a piercing light, inflicting Light damage on all foes on the field

7.text: Displays the majesty of an Ancient Dragon, inflicting a stackable Light resistance debuff on all foes on the field + Removes 1 buff / Emits a piercing light, inflicting Light damage on all foes on the field

8.text: I Am the Holy Dragon King!

2.text: The incarnation of a spirit jewel, and one of the Three Sacred Treasures. Long ago, she and her master were swallowed by a curse and became the Yamata no Orochi. Freed from that curse, she has become everyone's sweet Granny Tama. Ohagi are my specialty, dearie.

5.text: Uses the light of the magatama to increase the attack of Light units and Light multiballs + Grants Recover + Removes 2 debuffs

7.text: Uses the light of the magatama to increase the attack of Light units and Light multiballs + Grants Recover + Removes 2 debuffs

2.text: A martial arts master both kind and terrifying. Though she wields superhuman strength, she is a good soul whose hobby is helping and teaching others. Her way of thinking and her priorities, however, are beyond human understanding. Put simply, she doesn't understand the human heart.

5.text: Readies her spear in front, inflicting Dark damage and reduced Dark resistance on hit foes

7.text: Readies her spear in front, inflicting Dark damage and reduced Dark resistance on hit foes

2.text: A self-proclaimed priest who works as a gravekeeper in Palpebra. A man of few words who hates bother. Orders, restraints, even thinking: to him, it's all a bother. The first thing he ever truly wanted was the peace he found in Palpebra.

5.text: Slams his mace down on the nearest foe, inflicting Dark damage on hit foes / Increases attack for self

7.text: Slams his mace down on the nearest foe, inflicting Dark damage on hit foes / Increases attack for self

2.text: Hibiki Suminami, a teleporter. She loves music and turns all kinds of feelings into songs. Once tormented by severe anxiety, she recovered after a certain major incident. She is now helping rebuild Shibuya while sincerely facing the strange new world around it.

5.text: Inspires allies with a performance, sacrificing the HP of Dark units to increase their skill damage / Grants Song of the World to Dark units (excluding Hibiki) / If HP is below 40% when activated, restores own HP after 5 seconds

7.text: Inspires allies with a performance, sacrificing the HP of Dark units to increase their skill damage / Grants Song of the World to Dark units (excluding Hibiki) / If HP is below 40% when activated, restores own HP after 5 seconds

2.text: Second son of the Oxtan family, eighth of the Farlands' Nine Houses. A high priest, and a corrupt one at that. Having lost sight of the light and his star to anger and hatred, he met a beast that devours stars in the darkness.

5.text:

2.text: A girl who is terrified of ghosts. She took up qigong to ward off ghosts and for beauty and health, only to end up relied on to solve supernatural cases. To support her little brothers and sisters, she reluctantly faces the supernatural yet again today.

2.text: A sleep-inducing princess who wants to help all sorts of people. At Valentine's Fest, she's studying love as hard as she can. In her brand-new outfit, she uses her dream-showing power to lead lambs lost in love off to dreamland.

4.note: German "Traeum suess" (sweet dreams) punning on juice; umlauts avoided (not attested in EN data).

5.text: Brings sweet dreams, increasing the attack and Fire resistance of Water units and Water multiballs
